title: Dimension definition, schema v2
description: One dimension of the custom-dimensions mod for Minecraft 26.3. Field map: docs/design/rebuild-26/schema-v2.md. A file without "schemaVersion": 2 is a 1.21.1 definition; convert it with ./gradlew :compiler:convertDefinitions.

schemaVersion.description: Always 2. The 26.3 mod refuses a file without it.

description.description: What the dimension is, for players and the viewer.

seed.description: The world seed, or "env" for the server's SEED environment variable.

terrain.description: The terrain layer: a library terrain, its setting and parameters. base null keeps the preset's own terrain.

base.description: A library terrain; null is the generator preset's own.

setting.description: Starting values for the parameters: gentle (near vanilla), default, extreme.

params.description: Parameters of the base terrain, over its setting; each terrain's are under $defs/terrain_<base>.

scale.description: Horizontal stretch of every terrain noise and of the biome climate; 2 is twice as broad. scales multiply it per router noise

heightMultiplier.description: Multiplies every height above or below sea level

scales.description: Per-noise horizontal stretch, each multiplied with scale and applied to the router noise it names: continents (continentalness: continent and ocean size), erosion (range and valley width), ridges (weirdness: ridge, river and peak spacing), climate (temperature and vegetation: biome region size). Larger is broader. Library noises follow scale only. Biome climate boxes keep their bounds, so check every listed biome on a render after a change (T174). Without a base it shapes the overworld, large_biomes and amplified presets' own terrain.

continents.description: Horizontal stretch of one router noise, multiplied with scale; 2 is twice as broad

erosion.description: Horizontal stretch of one router noise, multiplied with scale; 2 is twice as broad

ridges.description: Horizontal stretch of one router noise, multiplied with scale; 2 is twice as broad

climate.description: Horizontal stretch of one router noise, multiplied with scale; 2 is twice as broad

layout.description: A large-scale shape added to continentalness (land and biomes both read it) so the bordered area composes as one place: radial is a continent (1 within radius, falling to -1 over falloff), ring is a crest at radius round a low centre, linear is a coast rising towards direction. The shape times strength adds to the noise, never replaces it. Without a base it shapes the overworld, large_biomes and amplified presets' own terrain.

centre.description: Block x, z of the shape's centre, or a point on a linear coast; default the border's centre, 0, 0

radius.description: Blocks from the centre to where a radial shape starts to fall, or to a ring's crest

direction.description: Degrees towards which a linear layout rises: 0 east, 90 south

falloff.description: Blocks over which the shape goes from land (1) to sea (-1)

strength.description: How far the layout moves continentalness: 1 adds the whole shape (-1 to 1), 0 none

biomes.description: Biome ids, or {id, climate} entries placing a biome by multi-noise climate.

biomeLayout.description: How a noise generator lays out the biome list. regions: every listed biome without a climate takes one large region on the region axes, a share of the world border equal to its weight over the sum, whatever the seed; consecutive biomes in the list share a border. A listed biome with a climate is bound to the land: it keeps its box, which wins over every region (oceans on continentalness, caves on depth, peaks on erosion). The axes are in rank space: -1 is the lowest value the seed reaches inside the world border (borders.player, else borders.generation), 1 the highest; a bound box on a region axis reads it the same way. Stretch the region axes with terrain.scales (climate for temperature and humidity) for fewer, larger regions.

axes.description: One or two slow axes the regions are cut on; default [temperature, humidity]. With two, the regional biomes fill columns along the first in list order and rows along the second.

weights.description: A regional biome's weight; 1 when absent. On a terrain with a coastline its share of its role's area is its weight over the sum of the weights in that area; otherwise its share of the border is its weight over the sum of the regional biomes' weights.

roles.description: A listed biome's role, over the one its tags or library entry give. On a terrain with a coastline, regional land, peak and wetland biomes take regions on land only, ocean biomes in the sea only, cave biomes under land at depth only; shore and river biomes listed without a climate take the terrain's shore and river bands, divided among them by weight.

sea.description: The biome of the sea when no ocean biome is listed, on a terrain with a coastline; absent: the vanilla ocean that suits the land biomes' mean temperature.

liquids.description: Sea level, the lava level, the fluid below sea level and the aquifer mode.

lavaLevel.description: Open cells below the lower of this and sea level are lava; the generator's own is -54.

aquifers.description: on: the preset's aquifers; off and flooded: none, so open cells below sea level hold the default fluid; dry: none, air as the default fluid, and no water springs or dripstone clusters.

basins.description: Fluid that fills a terrain's basins (basin_islands) and nothing else: open cells inside a basin, above its floor and below level; the void and the open sky stay air.

level.description: The fluid's surface; between the basin floor and the rim's top. Absent: the terrain's altitude, its water line.

materials.description: The material layer: the fallback block, a palette for the dimension and palettes per biome.

biomes.description: A palette per biome id or #tag, over the dimension's.

carvers.description: Vanilla carvers by name (canyon, cave, cave_extra_underground, nether_cave; a bare name is minecraft:): false removes it from every biome's carver list in this dimension, true adds it to every biome's.

ores.description: Ore veins, ores added to the dimension and placed features removed from it.

veins.description: true keeps the preset's veins, false removes them, a list replaces them.

zones.description: Shapes that replace layers inside them, in order.

dimensionType.description: Dimension-type fields; unset ones keep the base type's.

monsterSpawnLightLevel.description: A light level, or an int provider object.

rules.description: What works here; unset rules keep the base type's.

borders.description: World-border radius for players, and the pre-generation radius, in blocks.

structures.description: Structure control (worldgen.md § Structure control). Structure ids or #tags for force, wants, shuns, replace and terrainAdaptation; structure set ids for list, exclude, include, rarity and spacing.

density.description: Every noise group's profile, or theme factors on vanilla grids; none places no organic structure.

wants.description: Structures guaranteed between min and max blocks of spawn, by id, #tag or short name.

shuns.description: Structures that never place here, by id, #tag or short name.

spacing.description: A random-spread set's own grid, kept outside the noise groups.

mode.description: allow keeps only the sets in list, reject drops them, none drops every organic set.

force.description: A structure at a block position, or in a chunk within radius blocks of it; exclusive (default true) removes its organic copies.

clearSpawnRadius.description: Blocks round spawn where the dungeons and endgame groups place nothing.

terrainAdaptation.description: Terrain around a structure or a group's structures: a vanilla adjustment, or pedestal, platform_skirt and ground_blend as their vanilla counterparts.

noise.description: A profile for every group, a map of group to profile, or false for vanilla grids.

radial.description: A group's density from spawn to border, 10 points in 0-3.

include.description: Sets placed although no biome here suits them, on their own grids with the biome check skipped.

replace.description: Wherever the left structure would place, the right one does.

portals.description: The ways in. The first entry is the primary portal.

exits.description: Exit rules by trigger: void, death, death:<cause>, enderPearl, fallFrom.

deaths.description: What a player who dies here keeps (decisions.md RB-31). Absent, the keepInventory game rule decides.

wins.description: Wins (decisions.md RB-30): each grants the advancement <namespace>:wins/<slug>/<id> when its trigger fires.

like.description: The vanilla vein whose shape and heights it takes.

message.description: A key in config/messages.json; default win.earned. Variables: {player} {dimension} {win}.

exit.description: Where the player is sent after the win, in the ExitTarget grammar.

climate.description: Multi-noise placement: a point or a [min, max] range per parameter.

preset.description: The noise settings, for type noise, and for type single_biome (default overworld).

biome.description: The biome of a flat or single_biome world.

layers.description: A flat world's layers, bottom up.

endIsland.description: False removes the End's island at the origin. End preset only.

zone.description: A shape around spawn or a point that replaces layers inside it. Zones apply in order, each over the ones before it; outside them the definition's own layers hold.

shape.description: circle (radius), ring (inner, outer), square (radius: half its side), box (halfSize), sector (radius or outer, inner, angles) or polygon (points); all covers the whole dimension, for swaps.

centre.description: [x, z], or spawn: the definition's spawn (0, 0 without one).

radius.description: circle and square: blocks from the centre to the edge; sector: its outer radius.

inner.description: ring and sector: the hole's radius.

outer.description: ring and sector: the outer radius.

halfSize.description: box: half its size along x and z.

angles.description: sector: [from, to] in degrees from east (+x) towards south (+z).

points.description: polygon: [x, z] corners relative to the centre, at least three.

blend.description: Blocks beyond the edge over which the zone fades out; 0 is a hard edge.

edgeJitter.description: Blocks the edge wanders by noise (two standard deviations), so it reads as landscape.

terrain.description: The zone's terrain: a library terrain's name, or a terrain object as the definition's.

biomes.description: The zone's biomes, laid out as the definition's are; materials and ores follow them.

swap.description: Biome id to biome id, applied inside the zone; on shape all, everywhere.

aquifers.description: on keeps the dimension's; dry: no aquifer or sea water in the zone.

structures.description: Structure wants and shuns scoped to the zone, applied by structure control.

preview.description: See through the portal. On unless false; an object tunes it.
